frontmatter.name: Pydantic Anti-Patterns Remediation
frontmatter.overview: Remediate Pydantic anti-patterns, semantic issues, and bad code across the codebase based on the Pydantic best practices rules. Focus on mutable defaults, unsafe Any types, missing model configurations, and inconsistent security settings.

todos.content: Fix mutable default values in server/schemas/player.py (Field(default=[]) -> Field(default_factory=list))
Convert old dict-style model_config to ConfigDict in server/schemas/nats_messages.py and server/api/admin/npc.py
Add security model_config (extra=forbid, validate_assignment=True, etc.) to all models missing it
Create PlayerStatsModel and replace dict[str, Any] stats in server/schemas/player.py
Replace list[dict[str, Any]] inventory with list[InventoryItem] in server/schemas/player.py
Replace list[dict[str, Any]] status_effects with list[StatusEffect] in server/schemas/player.py
Create typed models for NPC base_stats, behavior_config, ai_integration_stub, spawn_conditions in server/api/admin/npc.py
Replace dict[str, Any] with proper types in server/schemas/profession.py ProfessionResponse
Use CommandMessageData and ChatMessageData instead of dict[str, Any] in server/schemas/websocket_messages.py
Update unit and integration tests to work with new typed models
Run mypy to verify type safety after all changes
Test that extra fields are rejected and validation works correctly
Add @field_validator and @model_validator where needed for custom validation logic following Pydantic v2 patterns
Create SecureBaseModel and ResponseBaseModel base classes with standard security configuration, then refactor existing models to inherit from them
Review validation logic for duplication, extract common validators to shared utilities, and ensure consistent naming conventions

frontmatter.name: app.state to dependency injection migration
frontmatter.overview: Migrate all services from app.state to ApplicationContainer-based dependency injection, eliminating the dual storage pattern and updating all 500+ access points throughout the codebase to use proper dependency injection.

todos.content: Extend ApplicationContainer with all missing services (combat, magic, NPC, chat, etc.)
Move service initialization logic from lifespan_startup.py into container.initialize()
Update initialize_container_and_legacy_services() to store in container first, then app.state for backward compatibility
Create dependency injection functions in dependencies.py for all new services (~18 functions)
Create Depends() aliases for all new dependency functions
Migrate API route handlers in server/api/*.py to use dependency injection
Migrate game_tick_processing.py to use container instead of app.state
Migrate admin_shutdown_command.py to use container for shutdown state
Migrate all command handlers in server/commands/*.py to use dependency injection
Migrate WebSocket and real-time handlers to use container
Remove dual storage pattern - stop copying services to app.state
Update test fixtures in conftest.py to use container-based dependency injection
Migrate all 445+ test instances across 35+ test files to use container
Remove deprecated code, update documentation, add linting rules
Run full test suite, verify zero app.state.* access, check coverage

nodes.label: Framework Behavior Tests

nodes.label: Option B Quick Wins First
nodes.rationale: Remove 60 obvious zero-value tests this week (placeholders, isinstance, duplicates) then proceed to full 2-month optimization; lowest risk path.

nodes.label: Phased Uplift Not Greenfield

nodes.label: Parametrize Repetitive Tests

nodes.label: PostgresConnection Context Manager

nodes.label: Semgrep Configuration
nodes.rationale: This file defines security audit rules for multiple languages (Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, YAML) to detect vulnerabilities like XSS, SQLi, XXE, and SSRF.

nodes.label: Java Jackson Deserialization Rule
nodes.rationale: Detects dangerous default typing in Jackson ObjectMapper (CWE-502).

nodes.label: Java JMS Deserialization Rule
nodes.rationale: Detects insecure deserialization in JMS MessageListener.onMessage (CWE-502).

nodes.label: Java Path Traversal Rule
nodes.rationale: Detects user-controlled file paths in File, FileInputStream, or FileOutputStream (CWE-22).

nodes.label: Java Unvalidated Redirect Rule
nodes.rationale: Detects open redirects via HttpServletResponse.sendRedirect or Location headers (CWE-601).

nodes.label: Java Weak SSL Context Rule
nodes.rationale: Flags insecure TLS/SSL versions and suggests upgrading to TLSv1.2 or higher (CWE-326).

nodes.label: Java XPath Injection Rule
nodes.rationale: Detects tainted input from HttpServletRequest reaching XPath evaluate or compile commands (CWE-643).

nodes.label: Java XSS Response Writer Rule
nodes.rationale: Detects user input flowing into OutputStream or Writer without escaping (CWE-79).

nodes.label: Java XXE DocumentBuilderFactory Rule
nodes.rationale: Detects insecure XML parsing configurations in DocumentBuilderFactory (CWE-611).

nodes.label: Spring SQL Injection Rule
nodes.rationale: Detects raw SQL construction using JdbcTemplate or PreparedStatementCreatorFactory (CWE-89).

nodes.label: Express JWT Hardcoded Secret Rule
nodes.rationale: Detects hardcoded secrets in express-jwt configuration (CWE-798).

nodes.label: Express Object Deserialization Rule
nodes.rationale: Detects RCE via node-serialize or serialize-to-js (CWE-502).

nodes.label: Express SSRF Rule
nodes.rationale: Detects user-controlled input crafting requests via the 'request' library (CWE-918).

nodes.label: Express XXE Rule
nodes.rationale: Detects insecure XML parsing using libxmljs, node-expat, or xml2json in Express apps (CWE-611).
